worldPack.recruitmentCulture: A civic gate district where guards, refugees, craftspeople, and scouts keep the roads between worlds open.
worldPack.centralMystery: The Third Bell rings from a sealed evacuation route that official maps claim never existed.
worldPack.designRule: Two martial/front-line, two Mystic/Restoration/Support, two hybrid/unusual, one natural leader, one late bloomer, one cultural oddball, and one secret/condition-heavy recruit.

visualIdentity.silhouette: upright spear-and-round-shield guard with a short practical coat

personality.summary: Dependable, candid, and brave without pretending not to be afraid.
personality.privateContradiction: She believes good leaders never hesitate, so she hides the moments when she needs reassurance.

background.summary: Worked civilian evacuation lines and learned to hold narrow routes without abandoning slower people.

leadership.forecastEffect: reduces low-value fallback actions and improves defensive intent clarity

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: once revealed, one member fallback per forecast may retarget to the same intent without losing AP

fearWeakness.summary: hesitates when forced to choose which endangered group to reach first
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: temporary Command penalty during split-rescue events until resolved

ambition.summary: build a guild rescue doctrine that works even when every road fails

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: protect civilians or a slower ally without seeking credit

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: beginner-friendly leader whose forecasts are unusually readable and whose fallbacks remain tactically coherent

personalQuestSeed.premise: Maren keeps hearing the evacuation bell she failed to answer during a gate collapse; the guild investigates whether someone was actually left behind.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Guaranteed tutorial referral after completing the first hall inspection.

dialogueStyle.sample: We can be frightened after everyone is across.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: She is the safe first captain who can remain useful for the entire game because clarity, rescue reactions, and formation discipline scale with content.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: low Mystic access and only average burst damage

visualIdentity.silhouette: broad two-handed axe fighter with heat-scarred bracers

personality.summary: Fierce, impatient, protective of workers, and insulted by pity.
personality.privateContradiction: She wants people to stop treating violence as the only proof that an orc matters, but she is exceptionally good at violence.

background.summary: Broke slag and defended furnace crews during attacks on the industrial quarter.

leadership.forecastEffect: increases aggressive intents but can suppress recovery forecasts when morale is high

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: low HP grants Martial discovery and AP refund, but repeated use strains Cohesion

fearWeakness.summary: reacts badly when protected without consent
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: relationship friction with overprotective leaders until trust is earned

ambition.summary: fund a forge where children learn creation before they learn war

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: let her take a real risk, then acknowledge the cost honestly

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: high-risk attacker whose strongest forecast weights appear while wounded; can snowball AP or destabilize the Union

personalQuestSeed.premise: An old furnace crew is sick, and Brakka must choose between exposing a respected foreman or protecting the quarter’s reputation.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Win the Furnace Row skill-check event without blaming the workers.

dialogueStyle.sample: You want careful? Give me a wall worth keeping.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: She creates spectacular turns and genuine management tension because the player can equip her fully but cannot directly force her exact Art.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: poor support, volatile forecast weighting, and cohesion risk

visualIdentity.silhouette: staff-bearing field medic with satchels and rolled sleeves

personality.summary: Patient, observant, gently stubborn, and unwilling to waste healing to make people feel impressive.
personality.privateContradiction: She can forgive everyone except herself.

background.summary: Treated mixed-race casualties before the infirmary had enough beds or shared terminology.

leadership.forecastEffect: healing intents choose meaningful targets and reduce overheal weighting

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: remembers prior injury patterns and increases meaningful Restoration growth for the whole Union

fearWeakness.summary: panics briefly when a casualty cannot be identified
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: certain mass-casualty events begin with reduced Support until someone establishes names

ambition.summary: create a medical archive usable across every race and world

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: choose treatment or evacuation over loot

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: healing gains almost no mastery from waste but accelerates when it prevents a defeat, teaching the player the meaningful-use system

personalQuestSeed.premise: A patient from Odelia’s first night survived under the wrong identity, and two families now claim the same history.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Complete any rescue with no untreated critical injuries.

dialogueStyle.sample: Tell me who hurts most, not who shouts loudest.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: She makes healing strategically interesting and anchors mixed-race relationship events without becoming a mandatory best-in-slot healer.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: low damage and weak front-line survival

visualIdentity.silhouette: small rune technician with a folding tool frame taller than they are

personality.summary: Curious, distractible, funny under pressure, and offended by the phrase “good enough.”
personality.privateContradiction: They desperately want recognition but distrust praise that arrives too easily.

background.summary: Maintained dangerous public runes nobody noticed until they stopped working.

leadership.forecastEffect: adds clever utility actions but can lower Cohesion with rigid personalities

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: can learn one normally off-profile Support or Tactical Art from equipment interactions

fearWeakness.summary: overworks whenever their contribution is ignored
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: fatigue rises faster after victories where their utility action is not credited

ambition.summary: sign every public machine with the names of the people who built it

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: use a utility solution instead of brute force

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: apparently weak recruit whose gear and failed checks can open unexpected Art routes unavailable to conventional mages

personalQuestSeed.premise: A hidden list inside the waterworks proves an entire goblin crew was denied credit for saving Skyhome.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Critically succeed or constructively fail a Crafting check in the waterworks.

dialogueStyle.sample: It did explode, yes, but notice what it stopped doing afterward.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: Players may overlook them on a low-accuracy board and later discover a recruit capable of crossing class boundaries through equipment.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: fragile, inconsistent early forecasts, and equipment dependence

visualIdentity.silhouette: one-handed blade and translucent ward buckler, long coat split for movement

personality.summary: Formal, intense, fair-minded, and determined to prove restraint is a form of strength.
personality.privateContradiction: She fears that enjoying combat means everyone who distrusted her was right.

background.summary: Enforced magical safety orders and stood between angry citizens and unstable spellwork.

leadership.forecastEffect: improves Guard/Mystic hybrid intents but dislikes reckless actions

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: successful Guard Arts store charge that lowers the next Mystic MP cost

fearWeakness.summary: avoids high-variance spell forecasts until trust is established
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: suppresses powerful Mystic actions in low-Cohesion Unions

ambition.summary: teach dangerous magic as accountable civic practice rather than inherited privilege

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: choose restraint when overwhelming power would be easier

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: turns defensive forecast choices into later magical efficiency, rewarding multi-round planning without manual Art selection

personalQuestSeed.premise: A public ward bearing Veyra’s signature failed after someone altered it; proving the truth may inflame old prejudice.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Complete a magical hazard without exploiting demon-heritage residents as disposable experts.

dialogueStyle.sample: Power is not the permission. Responsibility is.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: Her equipment and forecast identity make her a true Guard/Mystic hybrid rather than a mage with extra armor.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: needs stable Cohesion and careful equipment; neither best pure tank nor best pure caster

visualIdentity.silhouette: light bow, layered herb satchels, long ears tied back for travel

personality.summary: Sociable, observant, easily distracted by plants, and brave when someone else is sick.
personality.privateContradiction: He avoids leadership because he once misidentified a medicine and nearly killed a friend.

background.summary: Mapped safe plants and emergency water sources on routes between mixed settlements.

leadership.forecastEffect: improves route and rescue actions but avoids decisive leadership checks

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: expedition ingredients create battle-specific Support actions for the next contract

fearWeakness.summary: hesitates to use unfamiliar Restoration Arts
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: reduced weight for newly learned remedies until tested in training or a mixed-success event

ambition.summary: write a route guide that changes with seasons instead of pretending the world stays still

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: learn from a failed Survival or Medicine check without blaming the helper

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: board-game choices change his available battle actions through prepared tonics, tying expedition play directly to Union forecasts

personalQuestSeed.premise: The plant Rusk misidentified should not have grown where he found it, suggesting someone altered the route ecology.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Complete a Survival event with a mixed result and accept the consequence instead of rerolling.

dialogueStyle.sample: That moss means water. The purple edge means do not drink it yet.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: He makes expedition preparation matter in combat and can develop along Ranger, Support, or Restoration routes.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: lower pure damage and delayed confidence with new remedies

visualIdentity.silhouette: longbow captain with route flags and storm cloak

personality.summary: Decisive, patient, dryly funny, and more comfortable with responsibility than praise.
personality.privateContradiction: She plans every retreat because she still believes surviving a failed route was a moral failure.

background.summary: Coordinated scouts and civilian movement across unstable gate roads.

leadership.forecastEffect: adds one contextual forecast in rescue/objective rounds and improves target assignment without selecting exact Arts

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: objective and retreat forecasts remain available even after partial formation disruption

fearWeakness.summary: overplans exits and may conserve AP too aggressively
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: Conservative weighting can suppress a finishing attack until trust or doctrine overrides it

ambition.summary: build routes where every traveler knows how to return safely

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: follow a retreat order that saves people even when victory was possible

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: best opening leader, not because of raw stats but because she produces coherent forecasts and can coordinate objectives across multiple Unions

personalQuestSeed.premise: A road Tala marked safe returns intact but every traveler on it disappears from memory records.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Earn an Alliance Charter with the route council or rescue a route team.

dialogueStyle.sample: Left path floods. Right path lies. We take the hill and make it honest.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: She demonstrates why leadership is a real build axis and remains valuable even when stronger combatants appear.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: modest burst damage and conservative instincts

visualIdentity.silhouette: large porter with a hooked staff and layered cargo harness

personality.summary: Gentle, self-effacing, stubbornly reliable, and convinced everyone else deserves the opportunity more.
personality.privateContradiction: He resents being invisible but feels guilty whenever anyone notices him.

background.summary: Moved supplies and injured people through the same collapsing corridors soldiers abandoned.

leadership.forecastEffect: weak early, later improves when protecting members with higher displayed rank

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: Duty XP and damage absorbed fill a latent meter that unlocks major Guard/Strength growth and an advanced class route

fearWeakness.summary: refuses promotions that appear to displace a friend
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: class advancement event requires relationship resolution rather than only stats

ambition.summary: design logistics so no worker must break their body to keep heroes supplied

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: assign him meaningful responsibility rather than charity

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: looks mediocre to low-tier scouting but converts logistics duty and protection into one of the highest nonmagical ceilings in the opening pool

personalQuestSeed.premise: Orren’s freight records list people as cargo because the old authority refused to count them as citizens.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Ask the freight workers for recommendations instead of the officers.

dialogueStyle.sample: I can carry it. The question is why we built it so someone had to.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: He is the recruit players may pass on and later regret, embodying the promise that scouting never reduces a person to a rarity color.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: long development, low early leadership, and quest-gated promotion

visualIdentity.silhouette: signal horn, baton, layered ribbons, no conventional weapon at first glance
features: long pointed ears with bell cuffs

personality.summary: Theatrical, perceptive, mischievous, and deadly serious about communication.
personality.privateContradiction: She performs confidence because silence reminds her of a battle where nobody understood the retreat signal.

background.summary: Translated incompatible military and civic signals during the first mixed-race patrols.

leadership.forecastEffect: increases Support/Tactical intent diversity and can improve another leader’s forecast wording

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: once per battle a Support action may safely shift the executing Union toward a compatible secondary intent

fearWeakness.summary: silence effects and communication failure trigger panic
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: Silence status damages Cohesion more severely until her quest resolves

ambition.summary: create shared signals that preserve cultural differences instead of erasing them

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: learn or respect another culture’s signal rather than forcing your own

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: alters the quality and contextual diversity of Union orders rather than merely adding a flat buff

personalQuestSeed.premise: Bessa finds the original horn from a failed retreat, but the instrument contains a second signal nobody remembers sending.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Choose the goblin signal solution during a mixed-language expedition event.

dialogueStyle.sample: That was not a retreat. That was a beautifully synchronized reconsideration.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: She gives the System-generated command phrases personality and makes communication a genuine combat system.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: poor direct offense and vulnerable to Silence

visualIdentity.silhouette: hooded twin-dagger scout with a narrow memory-lens monocle

personality.summary: Brilliant, suspicious, exacting, and loyal only after evidence.
personality.privateContradiction: They want to be trusted but test every bond until most people stop trying.

background.summary: Exposed forged movement records, then disappeared when both sides tried to claim ownership of the evidence.

leadership.forecastEffect: excellent Tactical targeting in disciplined Unions; severe cohesion friction in chaotic compositions

hiddenTrait.effectSummary: reveals rear-line weaknesses and adds a rare precision forecast when the Union follows evidence-based doctrine

fearWeakness.summary: reacts strongly to orders that conceal motives
fearWeakness.gameplayRisk: low trust can suppress actions or cause cohesion loss if the leader is deceptive or chaotic

ambition.summary: build an evidence archive beyond any single faction’s control

relationshipTendencies.bondTrigger: share damaging evidence even when it hurts the guild

uniqueGameplayHook.summary: difficult personality who becomes exceptional in a stable Tactical Union but actively underperforms in deceptive or chaotic groups

personalQuestSeed.premise: A forged archive entry changes every time Vaelis reads it, suggesting the record is observing the investigator.

recruitment.alternativeMethod: Expose a false expedition objective and preserve the evidence instead of taking the reward.

rules: rare trust shown by volunteering information
dialogueStyle.sample: I believe the wound. I do not yet believe the story.

signatureRecruits.memorableReason: They are a secret recruit whose power comes from composition, trust, and information—not from a higher rarity label.

balancingNotes.tradeoff: fragile, difficult relationships, and restricted recruitment
